scenario: An independent recruiter returns to a sparse Today, asks a scoped question against canonical account data, inspects and disputes exact evidence, then opens the exact existing owned action without causing an external effect.
frozen_evidence: fresh PostgreSQL authority evaluator: R0 to R1 to R2, stale replay rejected, persisted lineage verified

review_plan.reason: The artifact claims a quiet, useful core workflow for a time-constrained independent recruiter.
The artifact reviews sensitive evidence, changes canonical evidence authority, and presents recovery state.
The release surface is a native iOS flow with Dynamic Type, interruption, focus, and recovery requirements.
Evidence correction and recruiter follow-through can affect candidate time, dignity, and trust.
The artifact does not assess, rank, score, predict, or infer candidate quality, fit, personality, or acceptance probability.

findings.observation: The in-flight review guard belongs to the current Ask view. Closing and reopening Ask can reconstruct an empty guard while the original task still owns the persisted pending operation, exposing a competing reconciliation control.
findings.evidence: Hash-matched RelationshipAskView.swift places the guard in view-local state and conditionally exposes Reconcile safely when the key is absent; runtime-evidence.json states that no delayed close-and-reopen recording exists.
findings.user_impact: Canonical state remains protected, but the recruiter can see conflicting progress and be invited to perform unnecessary recovery work.
findings.recommendation: Move live review-task ownership to a Session-level coordinator that survives Ask presentation changes, and reserve reconciliation for recovered or genuinely uncertain work.
findings.verification: Delay the endpoint, close and reopen Ask, and prove one progress state, no reconcile control, and one HTTP request; after process termination, prove one restored same-key reconciliation path.

strengths: The authority chain prevents stale success, Ask keeps mechanics progressively disclosed, and Open Pursuit reaches the exact action without recording work.
missing_evidence: Delayed close-and-reopen and kill-and-relaunch recordings, physical accessibility and microphone behavior, production Apple authorization, and field outcomes are absent.
open_questions: Should active evidence-review tasks live in the account Session coordinator?

reviews.lens: evidence integrity, identity and authority binding, privacy lifecycle, and safe human-controlled effects
strengths: The request and response bind prior and resulting review authority; locked current-only replay rejects stale R0 after R1 to R2; revocation, expiry, and deletion fail closed before replay; PostgreSQL verifies persisted lineage; iOS validates authority before applied state.
missing_evidence: Runtime same-key retries after revocation, expiry, and deletion; frozen recovery UI; physical accessibility and Apple Account behavior; production retention/export/deletion; evaluator calibration and field outcomes are absent.
open_questions: Will the authority evaluator execute outcome-unknown retries after revocation, expiry, and deletion?
What production evidence will verify export and end-to-end derived-store deletion?

reviews.lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: AX5 is frozen only for the initial conversation; the response, dispute, recovery, history, and exact-action destination have no full AX5 or physical assistive-technology proof.
findings.evidence: ui/ask-ax5.png and runtime-evidence.json missing_evidence; the selected Simulator bundle has no VoiceOver or Switch Control audit.
findings.user_impact: Later decision and recovery content could clip, reorder, or become difficult to reach for a recruiter using accessibility settings.
findings.recommendation: Run the complete critical path at AX5 on the smallest supported iPhone and a physical large iPhone, then manually inspect VoiceOver and Switch Control.
findings.verification: Every identity, effect, status, evidence, and action remains visible and reachable with correct accessible names, order, values, and focus.

findings.observation: Source separates live in-flight work from restored pending recovery, but no frozen delayed-endpoint or kill-and-relaunch transition proves the behavior.
findings.evidence: Hash-matched RelationshipAskView.swift and RelationshipArchiveModels.swift plus unit tests; runtime-evidence.json lists the transition recordings as missing.
findings.user_impact: Static proof cannot rule out a transient duplicate control, lost focus, stale message, or inaccessible recovery affordance at the moment of uncertainty.
findings.recommendation: Freeze a delayed live review and a protected pending process-termination/relaunch journey.
findings.verification: The live request shows progress with one request and no reconcile; relaunch shows one same-key reconcile control and one canonical review row.

strengths: Today has a clear resting point, Ask is conversation-first, and the exact action is visibly focused while preserving the no-write boundary.
missing_evidence: Direct physical interaction, complete AX5, assistive technology, localization, dark and motion variants, recovery transitions, microphone behavior, Apple authorization, and field outcomes are absent.
open_questions: Does the exact action remain centered and VoiceOver-focused at AX5 on the smallest supported iPhone?
Does a real process kill expose exactly one restored same-key recovery control before any new write?

reviews.lens: human connection, trust, agency, communication, collaboration

findings.criterion: Dignified failure, communication quality, and time respect
findings.observation: EVIDENCE_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_STALE is presented as a retryable save failure with the obsolete key even though a newer canonical decision already superseded it.
findings.evidence: Hash-matched RelationshipAskView.swift maps every backend error to failed and offers the same generic reconciliation; the frozen PostgreSQL evaluator proves the old key deterministically returns EVIDENCE_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_STALE.
findings.user_impact: The recruiter can enter a dead-end retry loop, misunderstand whether an earlier correction disappeared, and delay human follow-through.
findings.recommendation: Map stale authority to a terminal superseded state, keep the answer stale, remove same-key retry, and provide a fresh Ask or current-evidence path.
findings.verification: After another session advances R1 to R2, retrying R1 preserves R2 and shows a plain-language superseded card with no reconcile control or internal error code.

strengths: Candidate identity and attribution remain exact, the old answer cannot regain authority, Capture is purpose-bound, and no inspected surface ranks a person or claims an external effect.
missing_evidence: Terminal stale conflict UI, recovery transitions, physical accessibility and microphone behavior, Apple Account authorization, candidate-facing response commitments, production, and field outcomes are absent.
open_questions: What plain-language path should replace retry after a source decision is superseded?
What response commitment appears when a candidate is waiting on a client-owned dependency?

top_findings.reason: Ask dismissal can lose process-local task ownership and expose a competing reconciliation control while the original request is still active.
top_findings.next_step: Move task ownership to AppSession and reattach presentation to the live operation key.
top_findings.verification: A delayed close-and-reopen journey shows one live task, one request, and no reconcile control; process relaunch shows one restored reconcile path.

top_findings.reason: A stale authority conflict is shown as a retryable save failure, producing a dead-end recovery loop and inaccurate copy.
top_findings.next_step: Introduce a terminal superseded state with fresh Ask/current-evidence affordance and no obsolete-key retry.
top_findings.verification: Old R1 after R2 shows plain-language supersession, preserves R2, hides internal codes, and cannot reconcile the old key.

top_findings.reason: The critical path is not directly frozen at full AX5 or through physical assistive technology and interruption transitions.
top_findings.next_step: Freeze delayed/relaunch Simulator journeys, then run the complete path on physical accessibility settings when hardware and accounts are available.
top_findings.verification: All critical content and controls remain visible, correctly ordered, reachable, and truthful across AX5, VoiceOver, Switch Control, delay, termination, and relaunch.

agreements: No reviewer issued a veto, and the V8 stale-replay safety defect is closed for the frozen PostgreSQL gate.
Today, Ask, exact evidence, exact-action handoff, Capture, and Apple entry are materially quieter and preserve the no-external-effect boundary.
Local source, Simulator, unit, build, and PostgreSQL evidence cannot be converted into production, physical accessibility, or field-outcome proof.
adjudication.rationale: The local canonical loop is safe enough to continue and has no active veto, but two correctable recovery-feedback issues and missing physical, production, accessibility, and field evidence prevent a release pass or any 99-point experience claim. Specialist scores remain attached to their own rubrics and are not averaged.

next_tests.test: Delayed close-and-reopen plus process-kill evidence review recovery.
next_tests.evidence_required: Session-owned task test, UI transition recording, HTTP request count, persisted key readback, and canonical review-row count.
next_tests.pass_condition: Presentation reattaches to one live task; only genuine recovered uncertainty exposes one same-key reconcile action; exactly one canonical review exists.

next_tests.test: Terminal superseded-authority presentation after another session advances the review chain.
next_tests.evidence_required: Unit and UI proof tied to a real 409 EVIDENCE_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_STALE response and canonical R2 readback.
next_tests.pass_condition: R2 remains current; the old operation becomes plain-language superseded; no internal code or obsolete-key retry is visible; fresh Ask/current evidence is reachable.

next_tests.test: Complete Ask and exact-action loop at AX5, VoiceOver, Switch Control, production Apple authorization, physical microphone boundaries, and time-pressured field use.
next_tests.evidence_required: Physical-device recordings, accessibility transcript, Apple and microphone permission state, and structured recruiter/candidate observations.
next_tests.pass_condition: Critical content is reachable and truthful, authorization and interruption recover correctly, and field users complete the loop without avoidable delay or duplicate work.
